rules.accountSeparation: Future dedicated Testnet account distinct from ADMIN/SERVICE/COLLECTOR/RECYCLER/Wallet A/Wallet B. No app role, frontend identity, actor mapping, sponsorship or extra subentries.

custody.models: Maintenance-only secure slot with actual restricted independent loader, or separate owner-controlled local secret store inaccessible to business signer; slot naming alone is insufficient.

businessCap.laterSnapshots: Preserve legitimate later consumed/remaining snapshot summing to 18; do not reset to 15 after completed business RUNs.

rules.whitelist: Exact reviewed raw RUN manifest hashes, operation IDs, Battery/Request IDs and captured confirmed footprints. Canonical byte-sorted XDR deduplication. 30 is only a theoretical ceiling; ordinary one/three completed RUNs yield two/six unique keys.
rules.sameDeploymentWarning: Historical and fresh operations share deployment_id. Deployment rows, broad SQL lists and arbitrary discovery cannot select scope. Known retired identifiers rejected; future adapter must authenticate reviewed source bundles independently.
rules.cadence: 1000-10000 contiguous fresh observed ledgers; sample ends at latest current ledger/close time; rational arithmetic, no fixed five seconds. Projection is not a future network guarantee.
rules.relativeFormula: extendTo = TARGET_ABSOLUTE_LEDGER - CURRENT_LEDGER_AT_SIMULATION; <=0 means no extension; >maxEntryTTL-1 STOP without clamping.
rules.networkConfig: Fresh actual maxEntryTTL and footprint/read/write/key/transaction size/instruction/disk limits required. Missing/unknown/stale config STOP. Fixture limits are synthetic only.
rules.fee: margin=max(ceil(minResourceFee/5),100000); resourceFeeBudget=minResourceFee+margin; tx.fee=inclusionFee+sorobanData.resourceFee<=10000000. Integer stroops; no balance override or cap increase.
rules.simulationAndExtend: Maximum three simulations and three extends separately. One normal simulation/extend expected. Reserve before future effects, one fresh separately owner-reviewed lifecycle need per attempt. No retries/replacement/rebroadcast and no repeated RUN/scope/owner gate.
rules.restore: Not authorized; archived/expired required key STOP TTL_KEY_ARCHIVED_OWNER_DECISION_REQUIRED. Missing presence is not proof of nonexistence. No restore builder/path.
rules.transactionShape: Unsigned normal v1; one ExtendFootprintTtlOp, plain source, ext v0, no operation source override, memo, fee-bump, extra signer/auth, invocation/payment/createAccount/manageData/restore. RO exact effective approved ordered subset; RW empty.
rules.sourceState: Existing expected public key; one master signer weight1, thresholds 0/0/0, flags0/homeDomain empty/no sponsorship. Fresh account and final sequence reread; reject sequence drift. Balance never overrides fees.
rules.timebounds: minTime in [signingTime-30,signingTime]; maxTime>signingTime and <=signingTime+120. No missing/V2/expired preconditions.
rules.quiescence: Business worker quiet, no active business operation, pending signing, uncertain tx or concurrent lifecycle mutation; no external maintenance source use. Application lease does not protect from external submissions.
rules.preSignEntries: Fresh full key set with matching contract/key/durability entry-data XDR, persistent/TTL-eligible/PRESENT/readable liveUntil. Remove >=target as ALREADY_ABOVE_TARGET; zero remaining -> MAINTENANCE_NOT_REQUIRED, zero tx/simulation.
rules.postcheck: Original hash + SUCCESS receipt + ledger/header + independently verified existing master signature + fresh matching entries at/above target and observation at/after confirmation.
rules.uncertainty: Same original hash only. FAILED/EXPIRED/UNCERTAIN STOP; no rebroadcast/rebuild/replacement. Later same-hash success does not clear owner-review stop automatically.
rules.manifest: manifest.schema.json plus relational/XDR guards: classification, both ratified identities and auxiliary identity, source manifests/IDs, LedgerKey XDR/hash, exclusions, cadence/target, config/simulation, fees, unsigned/future signed hash, pre/post TTL and separate counters. Offline signedEnvelopeHash=null, tx hash explicitly unsigned/unsubmitted.
rules.futureBoundary: Offline supplied observations, booleans and review refs are not authenticated chain evidence. Live adapter/provenance validation, custody access-denial proof, persistent atomic global reservation journal, signing/sending/final sequence gate all require separate review and authorization. No live readiness claim.
